products.title: Peachy Dream Goat Milk Soap
products.descriptionHtml:
Deliciously sweet notes of juicy peaches capture the spirit of this perfect, market basket delight!

Handcrafted with a nourishing blend of plant-based oils, rich shea butter, and creamy goat milk, our soaps are made to give your skin a soft, clean, comfortable feel. Each bar is carefully crafted with olive oil, sweet almond oil, coconut oil, castor oil, and shea butter to create a creamy lather while helping cleanse without leaving your skin feeling overly stripped. Goat milk adds a creamy, silky quality, while kaolin clay provides gentle cleansing and a smooth skin feel. Every bar is beautifully scented with fragrance oil and colored with mica powder, making bath time feel a little more luxurious and special. Handmade in small batches with care, each bar is unique, because your everyday cleanse should feel like a treat.

Scent

Peaches & Crème. Top notes: pear, plum, grass, verbena. Middle notes: peach, jasmine, floral, violet. Base notes: praline, heliotrope, coconut, balsamic.

Ingredients

  • Olive Oil: A gentle, moisturizing oil that helps nourish and soften the skin while creating a mild, conditioning bar.
  • Sweet Almond Oil: Helps moisturize and condition the skin, leaving it feeling soft, smooth, and comfortable after cleansing.
  • Coconut Oil: Provides cleansing power and helps create a rich, bubbly lather while leaving the skin feeling refreshed.
  • Castor Oil: Helps create a creamy, stable lather and leaves skin feeling smooth and conditioned.
  • Goat Milk: Helps give the soap a creamy, silky lather and a soft skin feel.
  • White Kaolin Clay: A gentle clay that helps absorb excess oils while giving the soap a silky, smooth feel during cleansing.
  • Shea Butter: Helps nourish, soften, and condition the skin while adding a creamy, luxurious feel.
  • Distilled Water: Used to properly dissolve and combine the ingredients during the soap-making process.
  • Lye (Sodium Hydroxide): Essential for making true handmade soap; it reacts with the oils during saponification to create soap and glycerin. Once properly made and cured, no active lye remains.
  • Fragrance Oil: Gives each soap its unique scent and personality and is used according to appropriate skin-safe usage rates.
  • Mica Powder: A cosmetic colorant used to create beautiful colors and designs in the soap and is primarily used for appearance rather than skin-conditioning benefits.

Approx. 4–5 oz bar.

products.title: Buttercream Sugar Cookie Lotion Bar
products.descriptionHtml:
Treat your skin to rich, lasting moisture with our decadent Buttercream Sugar Cookie Lotion Bar, made with nourishing sweet almond oil, shea butter, coconut oil, and beeswax. This solid moisturizer melts with the warmth of your skin to help soften rough, very dry areas while sealing in moisture and helping reduce moisture loss.

Perfect for dry hands, elbows, knees, heels, and other areas that need a little extra care. Skin is left feeling soft, smooth, supple, and comfortable without the mess of a traditional lotion.

How to use

For best results, apply to slightly damp skin after bathing. Allow your body's natural warmth to soften the bar as you glide it directly over dry areas. Gently massage into the skin until absorbed.

Ingredients

  • Beeswax
  • Shea Butter
  • Sweet Almond Oil
  • Coconut Oil
  • Mica
  • Fragrance

2 oz.
